frozen.r1_reference_code: fig3_retarget/{views,models,rank,recursive}.py @ 209560f86f (unchanged; R2 ablations live in fig3_retarget/r2/ only)

definitions.N: all scene objects incl. target (and fixed bodies; TRAIN has none)
definitions.h: number of prior hypothetical edits before the scored local group

P1_supplied_assignments.labels: exact-compatible pool (R2.0 audit): snapshot labels + unchanged-teacher verifier caches on TRAIN/VAL roots; primary = VAL roots + TRAIN-cache labels NOT in the training snapshot; TRAIN snapshot labels = in-fit reference only

pairs.p11~X*Y: X and endpoint Y both decided

P1_supplied_assignments.strata: domain x N bin x m (1,2,3)
metrics: within-root top-1 verified rate vs random
P1_supplied_assignments.OOD_long_control: 3D K4/K5 cohort direct m = 4/5 labels (eval_primary / eval_oracle, exact) reported separately; 2D long control from kgt3 P5B only if exact-compatible

P2_rebase_h.Y: identical endpoint E: Y_global(original root, edit E) vs Y_rebased = no-op pY of rebase(root, E); h = |E| in 1..3; same teacher label
P2_rebase_h.X: local chunk pX at the rebased scene vs chunk X labels from R2.2 (same physical mode only)

R2_1_model_only.P3_retarget: C3/C3b TT_ADAPTER_V1 labels (exact; VAL; restricted candidate sets -> restricted diagnostic, not deployment): within-context dpY vs parent Y_tau change, admission (beats_empty: py_group > py_noop) false-negative / false-positive rates on decided candidates, rank of verified enablers by p11 / py; admit-all as bounded comparison
R2_1_model_only.P4_scoring: Y_global vs Y_rebased on identical endpoints; single-chunk p11 vs home-composition E on supplied labelled sequences; distributions by m, h, N, Y

R2_1A_matched_N.families: VAL roots, one per parent family, sha256('R2_N|'+root) order; need a decided verified repair (X=1, Y=1, m in {1,2}) AND a decided Y=0 endpoint (non-enabling) AND no-op Y=0 on the same root; 2D base N in [6,12], 3D base N in [3,6]
R2_1A_matched_N.rule: perturb.py R2_N_ADD_V1 (add-only, protected cells, nested prefix)

queries_per_variant.2d: X(repair, continuous) + Y(repair endpoint) + Y(no-op) + Y(negative endpoint) = 4
queries_per_variant.3d: X_CHUNKED(repair, y=t0) [X+Y] + Y(no-op) + Y(negative endpoint) = 3 jobs

R2_1A_matched_N.analysis: all attempted variants reported; label-change table; unchanged-label subset: |dp| and within-variant discrimination (p(pos) > p(neg)) vs base; never claims pure cardinality causation

R2_1C_omission.source: C3b blocked examples with |P| >= 2 whose full P verified-repairs the temporary task
R2_1C_omission.query: Y_tau(P minus p_i) via TT_ADAPTER_V1 for each i

R2_2_connectors.2d: VAL pool m=2 (24) and m=3 (16) sequences with decided continuous X (32 with X=1/Y=1, 8 with X=0 not at relocation 0), all split partitions (m=2: (1,1); m=3: (1,2),(2,1),(1,1,1)); continuous labels reused (x_chunked(bounds={m}) == x_query, R1 parity) + 8 continuous re-verifications as parity spot-check
R2_2_connectors.3d: 20 K4/K5 cohort witnesses: all-singleton partition (new) + archived continuous / chunked oracle runs (exact reuse); 4 VAL m=3 X=1 sequences x (1,2),(2,1),(1,1,1)
R2_2_connectors.gate: CONNECTOR_COMPATIBLE iff chunked verified rate >= 0.9 x continuous verified rate on the matched panel (raw paired counts + Wilson / bootstrap CI reported; engineering threshold, not statistical proof); else CONNECTOR_LIMITED

R2_3_search: only if R2.1 shows SCORER_SIGNAL for local m<=3 in that domain; development roots only (3D 20 cohort, 2D VAL engineering roster); equal expansion / readout / wall ceilings; funnel stages: eligible -> D4 -> legal groups -> scored -> staged beam -> admitted -> recursive variants -> retained -> final -> committed -> teacher; presealed physical sample of alternative candidates within the remaining budget

decision_rules.SCORER_SIGNAL: held-out local (m<=3) p11~X*Y AUROC lower CI > 0.60 AND within-root top-1 verified rate above random with family-cluster CI excluding 0
decision_rules.H_N_supported: natural panel: AUROC(highest populated N bin) <= AUROC(lowest) - 0.05 with CI of the difference excluding 0 (>=10 mixed families per bin), AND matched panel shows reduced within-variant discrimination on the unchanged-label subset (direction consistent); otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED (or UNIDENTIFIABLE if support missing)
decision_rules.H_m_supported: AUROC(m=3) <= AUROC(m=1) - 0.05 with CI excluding 0, or m=4/5 OOD control below SCORER_SIGNAL threshold
decision_rules.H_h_supported: Y_rebased vs Y_global AUROC difference CI excluding 0 (either direction reported)
decision_rules.H_T_supported: temporary-task pY AUROC CI upper bound below original-task pY AUROC lower bound on matched-size panels
decision_rules.RETARGET_SIGNAL: within-context dpY ranks verified enabling groups above non-enabling / nuisance groups (concordance CI > 0.5)
decision_rules.SEARCH_LIMITED / FROZEN_MODEL_LIMITED: per plan section 6; multiple labels allowed; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
